angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 751,189 km at 161.87 pc = 0.06 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 6.1777 +/- 0.0100 mas (same row, RUWE 0.87): 161.87 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 1.07976 solar radii from Lafarga et al. 2026, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TIC 161045582 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026MNRAS.548ag512L/abstract): 751,189 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.948 (0.908 to 0.988) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5683.87 K from Lafarga et al. 2026, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TIC 161045582 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026MNRAS.548ag512L/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Lafarga et al. 2026, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TIC 161045582 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026MNRAS.548ag512L/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/tic-161045582.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.348, rounded to two decimals
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TIC 161045582 (pscomppars): [M/H] 0.188 dex, from TICv8 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019AJ....158..138S/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TIC 161045582 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 0.07687, from TICv8 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019AJ....158..138S/abstract)
ageSource: Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 1590822939745962240, flags_flame 00: age_flame 9.835635 Gyr (16th to 84th percentiles 8.661765 to 11.00918)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: SIMBAD, TYC 3477-926-1: projected rotation speed 2.31 km/s, the measurement SIMBAD prefers (2022ApJS..259...35A)
